mentions.name: MyApps
mentions.description: MyApps is an operating system that runs in the browser, equipped with apps written for it. Built with GunDB and Svelte, it is an offline-first web of apps running entirely on the user's device, with privacy and data security built in.
mentions.source_excerpt: * My magnum opus, "MyApps" (https://myapps.ideasofhakki.com/) - This is no less than an OS running in your browser, equipped with whatever "Apps" written in it. I am building it with GunDB and Svelte and foundationally it will be a web of apps running completely in your device (i.e. offline first), with privacy and data security built-in.
mentions.author: hrkucuk
